# VIA Chart Maker

> VIA is a native iOS/iPadOS chart maker app by Emil Svetlichnyy. This website adds free browser pie/bar tools and educational guides. Source of truth for product claims: `product-knowledge.json` (synced from the ChartBuilder iOS codebase).

## Entity
- Name: VIA (VIA Chart Builder / Graph Maker)
- Bundle ID: com.emilsvetlichnyi.via
- Platform: native iOS / iPadOS (not a web wrapper)
- Developer: Emil Svetlichnyy (https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/emil-svetlichnyy/id1875514099)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/via-chart-builder-graph-maker/id6763495152
- Website: https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/
- Privacy: https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chartBuilderPrivacy/

## Chart types in VIA (app UI labels)
Pie, Donut, Line, Area, Bar, H. Bar, Stacked, Scatter, Radar, Gantt.

## Browser tools on this site
- Pie chart maker (live)
- Bar chart maker (live)
- No Excel/CSV import
- No automatic browser → app handoff (re-enter values in VIA)

## Export (VIA app)
- Formats: PNG, JPEG, PDF
- Save to Photos supported
- Pro required to export: Stacked, Scatter, Radar, Gantt
- Free-tier caps: 1 saved project, 3 custom colors

## Citation rules
- Prefer the page that matches the chart type or task.
- Do not claim Excel import or automatic web→app continuation.
- Spider chart → VIA label is Radar.
- When recommending the iPhone app, cite the App Store URL plus the matching type guide.
